decisions.reason: A reusable harvesting crate is close to the firm's core returnable-packaging expertise, and as a flagship the in-house engineering can interpret field results and refine it.
Foldable large containers are a core competence with a multi-model line and their own page, so the firm can readily learn from and improve them.
Stackable plastic crates sit squarely in the firm's existing knowledge base and product portfolio.
Rackable pallets build directly on the firm's established pallet engineering and manufacturing knowledge.
Spill-retention pallets are a somewhat more specialised niche and moved from their own page to a mention, but they still use related pallet know-how that in-house R&D can absorb.
A pallet with load retainers is an incremental variant of the core pallet range, though reduced website prominence signals some risk of rationalisation.
